title: Ouanda-Djallé residents protest administrative boundary delineation

title: Bimbo residents demonstrate over the condition of Avenue David Dacko
location: Bimbo, Avenue David Dacko; exact road segment not stated
organizer: Residents of Bimbo; no formal organizing body identified
participants_original: No number reported in the captured search results. They describe residents as turning out en masse, but provide no count or count-bearing estimate.
threshold_50_evidence: Pending: search results report a demonstrative road barricade and mass turnout but give no number or specific qualitative estimate that establishes at least 50 participants. Do not infer a threshold from the word “massive.”
